name: 06793 · Washington, CT
findings: ZIP 06793 (Washington) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (80%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06793 (Washington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06793 (Washington) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 7.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
